profile.name: Collin Brown
profile.role: Workplace operations and employee experience | Global commercial real estate firm
profile.headline: I make workplaces reliable, welcoming, and ready for what comes next.
profile.summary: As a Workplace Coordinator with a global commercial real estate firm, I support workplace operations and employee experience for a technology client in San Francisco. I connect people, facilities, vendors, and daily service needs so teams know what is happening, who owns the next step, and what good looks like.

projects.summary: Supporting a consistent workplace experience through clear ownership, dependable service routines, and close coordination between technology-client stakeholders and commercial real estate service partners.

narrative.challenge: A strong workplace experience depends on many services that people rarely notice until something breaks. Requests, vendor work, facilities needs, and team priorities must stay connected without adding noise for employees.
narrative.solution: Created a clear operating rhythm across technology-client stakeholders and commercial real estate service partners. Each request moves from intake to an owner, a next step, and a documented outcome. Risks surface early, and partners have the context they need to act.
narrative.outcome: The workplace runs with clearer ownership, stronger follow-through, and a more consistent employee experience. Weekly updates preserve decisions, service improvements, and evidence that can demonstrate the program’s impact.

wins: Coordinated daily workplace service delivery across technology-client stakeholders and commercial real estate service partners.
Turned workplace requests into clear priorities, owners, and next steps.
Tracked service outcomes, recurring issues, and evidence of workplace improvements in one weekly record.
asset_gaps: Before-and-after proof of a service improvement

preview_items.title: Keeping a Workplace Move Bid on Track
preview_items.wording: Coordinated a vendor walkthrough and proposal process for a workplace move, flagged a scheduling risk, and cleared a compliance issue that could have limited vendor options.

preview_items.title: Coordinating a Time-Sensitive Workplace Visit
preview_items.wording: When an external photography visit conflicted with a business-critical session, I adjusted the timing, met and escorted the visitors, and kept both activities running smoothly.

pipeline.name: Intake
pipeline.description: Capture workplace requests, service needs, risks, and employee feedback without losing context.

pipeline.name: Align
pipeline.description: Set the priority, owner, next step, and timeframe for each item.

pipeline.name: Deliver
pipeline.description: Coordinate facilities and vendor partners, then keep client stakeholders informed.

pipeline.name: Capture
pipeline.description: Document the outcome, impact, and proof so improvements remain visible and reusable.
